The '''Kothlis shadowport''' was a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] located on the [[Kothlis' second moon|second moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] that offered limited [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] services to [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. It was administered and maintained by the former pirate [[Rithgar]].
==Layout==
The shadowport consisted of spacious underground chambers and craters interconnected by a series of tunnels linking surface entrances and underground chambers. Several caves were excavated and furnished, and were provided to visiting smugglers. Specifically 14 craters were excavated, enlarged, and reinforced in order to be used as small-size [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] (Larger [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] and pirate [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] had to land outside the bounds of the security of the craters, in nearby clearings).<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Four chambers were used as storage bays, housing heaping piles of equipment and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components. [[Power coupling/Legends|Power couplings]], [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computers]], [[sensor/Legends|sensor]] equipment, [[hull]] parts, and a few malfunctioning [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] parts were available, but chaotically disorganized and took effort to locate. One additional chamber was dedicated to non-perishable [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]], bins with fresh [[water/Legends|water]], as well as [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrods]], [[datapad/Legends|datapads]], [[Syntherope/Legends|syntheropes]] and other essential supplies.<ref name="guide" />

A small command area was equipped with outdated machines that controlled the base [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]], [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite, and communications systems. Rithgar relied on his visitors's donations to upgrade it.<ref name="guide" />

One particular cavern adjacent to the Command Center served as Rithgar's personal quarters, decorated with his bed, [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] carpets, [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Tapestry/Legends|tapestries]], crystals, [[Holographic art|holo artworks]] and other plunder; some bins contained his personal treasures that he he had hoarded, as well as a disguised bar with vintage liquor. One of the tapestries hid an exit to a tunnel and a crater with Rithgar's personal [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]].<ref name="guide" />

The shadowport's only defenses were outdated sensor pods around the perimeter.
==Available facilities==
The facilities were available for free, but Rithgar expected crews to leave behind an adequate share of supplies and any spare [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts, hoping to upgrade his command center equipment.<ref name="guide" />

Fourteen [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] were made out of converted craters, in which [[Light freighter/Legends|leight freighters]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] could land. Electromagnetic countermeasure [[CN-15 camouflage netting|camo-netting]] was available in storage bunkers near crater rims, by which the contents of craters could be hidden. Ships that needed repairs had to be repaired by their own owners and crew.<ref name="guide" /> Some abandoned and scrapped ships were available for salvage for those willing to buy the rights to them.

About three caves, dismal and gloomy, meagerly furnished with old cots and crates, were provided to visiting smugglers who didn't wish to stay in their ship quarters. As they were few, one had to wait their turn until one was vacated. A spacious chamber, with several tables and chairs (complemented by empty [[transcube]]s) was a meeting area for all the visiting outlaws. This Common Room was mostly used for exchanging information, arguments, and play [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="guide" />

An additional 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] were required if someone wished to peruse the chaotic hoards of equipment and spare parts in the storage bays.<ref name="guide" />

==History==
The second [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] was once a military training ground and ordnance testing facility for the [[Bothan Militia]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The craters left from [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] blasts and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] explosions were opportune for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] looking to dock their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in a somewhat protected and isolated area on the abandoned moon.<ref name="guide" /> 

Smugglers and pirates and anyone who knew about it, visited freely. As violence was not tolerated, rival groups had to ignore each other. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] learned its location and used its services.<ref name="guide" /> 

At least one time, [[Ukert]], who claimed to owe Rithgar a debt, would dump smuggled shipment, such as [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power packs]] and [[blaster gas/Legends|gas]] canisters, to one of the shadowport's spare parts bays, so that the Alliance would supply from these.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Garbage Run|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the shadowport was evacuated due to the appearance of a [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|''Super''-class Star Destroyer]] in nearby space.
